focus.title: 欧盟拟对中国电动汽车加征临时反补贴关税，税率最高达38.1%
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于6月12日宣布，拟对进口自中国的电动汽车加征最高38.1%的临时反补贴关税，其中比亚迪17.4%、吉利20%、上汽38.1%。该措施将于7月4日起实施，除非欧盟成员国多数反对。受影响企业可申请听证或提交价格承诺。建议中国车企立即评估供应链调整方案，并启动欧盟法院诉讼准备。
focus.title_en: EU Proposes Provisional Anti-Subsidy Tariffs of Up to 38.1% on Chinese EVs
focus.summary_en: On June 12, the European Commission announced provisional anti-subsidy tariffs of up to 38.1% on imported Chinese EVs, with BYD at 17.4%, Geely at 20%, and SAIC at 38.1%. The measures take effect July 4 unless a qualified majority of EU member states opposes. Affected companies may request hearings or offer price undertakings. Chinese automakers should immediately assess supply chain adjustments and prepare for EU court challenges.

case.title: 最高法发布跨境贸易典型案：跨境电商未明示退货地址被判欺诈
case.summary: 最高人民法院6月15日发布涉外商事海事典型案例。其中，跨境电商A公司未在平台显著位置披露退货实体地址，导致消费者无法退货，被认定构成欺诈，判决三倍赔偿。该案明确：跨境电商经营者应遵守消费者权益保护法，须提供真实、有效退货地址，否则可能承担惩罚性赔偿。建议出海企业自查平台合规。
case.title_en: Supreme Court: Cross-Border E-Commerce Platform's Failure to Disclose Return Address Constitutes Fraud
case.summary_en: On June 15, the Supreme People's Court released typical foreign-related commercial and maritime cases. In one case, cross-border e-commerce company A failed to prominently display a physical return address on its platform, preventing consumers from returning goods. The court ruled this constituted fraud, awarding triple damages. The case clarifies that cross-border e-commerce operators must comply with consumer protection laws and provide valid return addresses, or face punitive damages. Outbound businesses should review platform compliance.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区出台数据跨境流动新规，简化个人信息出境合规流程
policy.summary: 广东省网信办6月20日发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动便利化措施（试行）》，明确区内企业通过订立标准合同即可实现个人信息跨境传输，无需单独通过安全评估。新规适用于大湾区内地九市与港澳之间的数据流动，涵盖金融、医疗、电商等领域。企业需在30日内向网信部门备案。此举将大幅降低合规成本。
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Issues New Rules to Simplify Cross-Border Data Flow Compliance
policy.summary_en: On June 20, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province issued the 'Pilot Measures on Facilitating Cross-Border Data Flow in the Greater Bay Area,' allowing enterprises to transfer personal data abroad by signing standard contracts without separate security assessments. The rules apply to data flows between nine mainland cities and Hong Kong/Macau, covering finance, healthcare, and e-commerce. Companies must file with the cyberspace authority within 30 days. This significantly reduces compliance costs.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · 2026.06.20

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：中企应对欧盟反补贴调查应主动提交价格承诺并准备司法挑战
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟对华电动汽车反补贴调查已进入关键阶段，企业应主动利用价格承诺机制争取豁免，同时同步准备向欧盟普通法院提起诉讼，挑战调查程序与实体认定的合法性。建议企业聘请专业律师团队，在7月4日前提交书面意见，并保留完整出口数据以应对后续复审。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Chinese Companies Should Proactively Offer Price Undertakings and Prepare Legal Challenges in EU Anti-Subsidy Probe
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: As the EU anti-subsidy investigation into Chinese EVs enters a critical phase, enterprises should proactively use the price undertaking mechanism to seek exemptions while simultaneously preparing to challenge the investigation's procedural and substantive legality before the General Court of the EU. It is recommended to hire a professional legal team, submit written comments before July 4, and retain complete export data for subsequent reviews.
